svg.title: ZeroTurn terminal demonstration
svg.desc: A terminal types four commands. The ZeroTurn status line shows context at 82 percent, five hour usage at 81 percent, seven day usage at 47 percent, a session of 3 hours 12 minutes, 2 active subagents, and the word ask. The subagent gate then returns an ask decision with the reason: New subagent requires approval. Context is 82% and five hour usage is 81%. zeroturn verify passes two checks, and zeroturn ship with dry run passes the same checks and prints READY TO SHIP. The session values are sample data.
